segments.text: Setsuna's classmate and childhood friend. He learnt martial arts together with her and is arguably more skilled than she is, however he lacks the sisters' ability to harm demons. He is privy to the sisters' secret occupation as exorcists and tries to help them anyway he can. He flags up the increasing frequency of demonic possession to Setsuna and is concerned about the trouble it forebodes.

After Yuuka's disappearance, he worries about the burden on Setsuna as the sole remaining exorcist in their town and eventually volunteers as an apprentice exorcist. The local priest who has watched over the sisters since they were children agrees, as the Church HQ has sent out orders that Setsuna be protected and her stubborn refusal to accept new partners allows him to assign Touma as her bodyguard.

After their first exorcism together, Touma gathers his resolve to assist Setsuna in any way he can, even if he cannot help in the actual battle against the demon. He is surprised at how draining the process is, despite being in decent physical shape himself.

When the demon cult makes its move for Setsuna, Touma is also captured despite the pair's best efforts to escape. He is then used as a bargaining chip to coerce Setsuna into deceiving her fellow classmates to serve as fellow breeding vessels.

In the bad end, he is executed by the cult when Setsuna openly disobeys orders. In the true end he succeeds in sending out an SOS to the Church HQ. He then prepares a ruse to deceive the cult into letting him out to bring the girls in Setsuna's stead. Eventually he brings reinforcements from the Church and helps rescue the sisters.
Despite seeing what Setsuna went through and being an unwilling accessory to her ordeal, he continues to treat her as before despite his growing romantic feelings for her.
刹那と悠果の幼なじみ。
幼い頃から刹那と一緒に武術を習っていて、師範代を任せられる程の実力の持ち主。
穏やかで基本的に争いごとは好まない性格をしている。
しかし、いざと言うときは身の危険を顧みず戦いの場へ飛び込む勇気を持っている。
悪魔を祓う力は無いものの、サポートとして刹那たちと行動を共にしている。
実は密かに刹那のことを女性として意識しているのだが、未だ幼なじみの関係からは抜け出せずにいる。

The only daughter born to a civil servant father and a medium mother.

Her mother possessed strong spiritual powers and used them to help people, but because of those powers, she was targeted by a powerful evil entity and, along with her father who tried to protect her, lost her life.
At that time, Hibiki was also targeted, but she was saved at the last moment by Uta. After surviving, she trained with Karen under Uta's guidance and acquired the strength to fight demons on her own.
She attends school during the day and, after school, works as an exorcist at Uta's “Kukan Clinic” alongside Karen.
She aspires to become a nurse, but her current priority is to find the demon who killed her parents.
She has a calm demeanor and is often perceived as more mature than her peers.
She rarely shows her emotions and is often mistaken for being cold-hearted, but she simply finds it difficult to express her feelings. She has a kind-hearted side that cannot ignore those in need.
She truly respects Karen, with whom she conducts exorcist activities, but she does not voice this admiration, as doing so would lead to Karen becoming overly persistent.
Translated from the official site
Although both of her parents are still alive, she has now moved away from them and is living with her grandmother, Uta.
She was born with psychic abilities, able to see and hear things that most people cannot.
Because of this, she was often feared by those around her as a child and was often isolated.
However, she gradually learned to control her abilities and is now able to communicate smoothly with those around her.
Currently, while attending school, she is also engaged in exorcism activities alongside Hibiki.
She is academically outstanding and aspires to become a doctor in the future, but she prioritizes helping Hibiki achieve her goals first.

She often gives off a cool impression at first glance, but she is relatively laid-back. Despite her laid-back nature, she is deeply compassionate and will go to great lengths for those she considers allies. On the other hand, she is extremely ruthless toward those who betray others.
She is like a childhood friend to Hibiki, but she thinks of her as a true family member. She wants to act like an older sister and pamper Hibiki, but Hibiki usually dodges her.
Translated from the official site
A mentor figure to Hibiki and Karen.
Possessing high psychic abilities, she was active as an exorcist for a while, but is now retired. She was injured in a battle with demons and now lives in a wheelchair.
She took Hibiki and Karen under her wing and trained them to fight demons.

She has a wide network of connections, with disciples and acquaintances involved in the occult all over the country. She also has many acquaintances in the police, political circles, and exorcist organizations, and has access to a wide range of information.
Despite her age, she is highly adaptable, skilled at using smartphones and the internet, and sensitive to current trends.
